validation.notes: Bugfix flow — no DISTILL .feature files exist, so steps carry test_file but no scenario_name. R3 decided option (a) by maintainer 2026-07-27: predictability keeps workItemLookup's full input set.

phases.name: Category-scoped metrics fetching
phases.description: Gate the 17 eager useMetricsData effects on the set of categories the user has actually visited, monotonic within an (entity, startDate, endDate) window.

steps.name: Declare widget fetch requirements in categoryMetadata
criteria: MetricsFetchKey union and getFetchKeysForCategories exported from categoryMetadata.ts
Every widgetKey in every category for both owner types has a widgetFetchRequirements entry
Requirements cover widget body AND RAG footer AND trend AND view-data sources
getFetchKeysForCategories respects ownerFilter via getWidgetsForCategory
No behaviour change yet — pure additive data plus its completeness test
steps.implementation_notes: RCA §5.1. This is the load-bearing step: a missing requirement blanks a RAG chip or empties a drill-in table on the default view (risks R1/R2). Derive each entry by reading the widget's node in buildWidgetNodes, its footer in buildWidgetFooters, its trend in the trend block, and its buildViewData sources in BaseMetricsView.tsx — not from the widget body alone. Non-obvious entries required by RCA §2/Q5: percentiles needs cycleTimeData; featureSizePercentiles needs featureSizeData; blockedOverview needs blockedCountHistory; totalWorkItemAge needs totalWorkItemAge; loadBalanceMatrix needs pbcCore + totalWorkItemAge; totalWorkItemAgeOverTime needs pbcCore + wipOverTime; workItemAgePercentiles needs inProgressItems; stacked needs throughput + arrivals + wipOverTime. pbcCore = {getWipPbc, getTotalWorkItemAgePbc}; pbcCharts = {getThroughputPbc, getCycleTimePbc, getArrivalsPbc}. R3 DECIDED option (a): every predictability widget also declares workItemLookup's inputs (throughput, wipOverTime, cycleTimeData, inProgressItems, and for portfolio the features source) because buildWorkItemLookup at BaseMetricsView.tsx:1545-1553 feeds every PBC node. Do NOT trim those to make the numbers look better.

steps.name: Accumulate visited categories monotonically
criteria: useVisitedCategories(selectedCategory, resetToken) returns a set that only grows
Revisiting a category does not duplicate or shrink the returned set
Changing resetToken resets the set to just the current selection
Initial render includes the initially selected category
steps.implementation_notes: RCA §5.2. Monotonic-within-a-window is what keeps category switching free on re-visit; there is no cache in this codebase (RCA §2/Q3), so the gate itself must never flip true->false inside a window. resetToken is entity id plus the formatted local start/end dates.

steps.name: Gate useMetricsData effects on active fetch keys
criteria: useMetricsData takes a 5th activeFetchKeys param defaulting to all keys
Each effect returns early unless its key is active and lists that boolean in deps
A key flipping false to true fetches exactly once; staying true never refetches
Batches split by consumer: ageInState and cumulativeStateTime separate, pbcCore separate from pbcCharts, portfolio group split
Existing useMetricsData tests pass unchanged
steps.implementation_notes: RCA §5.3. Effects to gate live at useMetricsData.ts:195-492. Default the new param to the full key set so all ~18 existing renderHook call sites compile untouched (risk R7) — keeps the diff honest. Batch splits: :284-321 keep {getCycleTimeData, getCycleTimePercentiles, getWorkItemAgePercentiles x2, flowEfficiency} together and move getAgeInStatePercentiles + getCumulativeStateTimeForTeam into their own gated effects; :468-492 split into pbcCore {getWipPbc, getTotalWorkItemAgePbc} and pbcCharts {getThroughputPbc, getCycleTimePbc, getArrivalsPbc}; :323-346 split into three gated groups AND convert its serial await chain to Promise.all (CF-1); :229-251 split getWorkInProgressOverTime into its own gated effect and Promise.all the remaining two (CF-1). Sibling effects still dispatch in the same commit so the D18 parallel intent at :253-257 survives. Do not introduce refs or latches — a plain boolean in the dep array is sufficient given monotonicity.

steps.name: Wire the gate into BaseMetricsView and pin the bug
criteria: On flow-overview mount, PBC, ageInState, cumulative, wipOverTime, estimation and blackout fetches are not called
Each flow-overview fetch is called exactly once on mount
Switching to an unvisited category opens its gate and fetches its set once
Returning to a visited category triggers no refetch — every fetch still called exactly once
Every widget in every category and owner type still renders its header and view data
steps.implementation_notes: RCA §5.4 + §8.1. This step contains the regression test for Bug #5571 — write it FIRST and confirm it goes RED against the current eager behaviour before wiring. Hoist ownerType (BaseMetricsView.tsx:1379-1380) and useCategorySelection (:1539) above the useMetricsData call (:1268); both depend only on metricsService and entity.id and neither reads hook output, so it is a pure reordering (risk R8). Compute visitedCategories via useVisitedCategories with resetToken `${entity.id}:${formatLocalDate(startDate)}:${formatLocalDate(endDate)}` (formatLocalDate already imported at :1214), then activeFetchKeys via useMemo over getFetchKeysForCategories(visitedCategories, ownerType). Spy on the IMetricsService mock (the port boundary), not the HTTP client — createMockMetricsService at BaseMetricsView.test.tsx:733 already makes every method a vi.fn(). Reuse the localStorage category-preselection pattern at :5335/:5481 to open on a chosen category. The visit-leave-return assertion is the load-bearing one: it is what fails if someone later 'fixes' eagerness naively and reintroduces refetch-on-switch (risk R4). Also assert a date change still refetches (risk R5).

steps.name: Remove duplicate total work item age fetch
criteria: TotalWorkItemAgeWidget takes a totalAge prop instead of fetching
The widget performs no service call of its own
Null totalAge still renders the existing loading branch
getTotalWorkItemAge is called exactly once per mount across the whole view
steps.implementation_notes: RCA §5.5 / Root Cause D. The parent already holds totalWorkItemAge (BaseMetricsView.tsx:1253) from useMetricsData.ts:213-220, so the widget's own useEffect is a pure duplicate. Same lift already applied to Flow Efficiency in 93eafd3a8. Keep totalAge as number | null so the widget's existing null branch covers loading (risk R9). MUST be its own commit so a bisect can separate it from the gating change.

steps.name: Refresh stale widget mock and claim
criteria: The TotalWorkItemAgeWidget mock reflects its real totalAge prop contract
getTotalWorkItemAge is asserted called exactly once on a flow-overview mount
The stale D7 comment no longer claims Flow Efficiency is the only self-fetching widget
steps.implementation_notes: Added after 01-05 reported two staleness items it could not fix inside its own boundary. The mock at BaseMetricsView.test.tsx:406 still destructures entityId/metricsService, props 01-05 removed; nothing asserts on the widget-entity-id / widget-has-service testids, so the suite stayed green while the mock silently drifted from the real contract. The D7 comment at :5343 claims Flow Efficiency is the only Flow Overview widget off the shared data path — false when written (RCA Branch D) and now false in a second way. Test-hygiene only; no production change.

steps.name: Close mutation gaps in the gate
criteria: An empty active-key set performs no service call at all
isProjectMetricsService rejects a service missing any one of its five probe methods
Mutation score for useMetricsData.ts reaches at least 80 percent
steps.implementation_notes: Stryker feature-scoped run measured useMetricsData.ts at 75.66 percent, dragging the feature total to 78.61 under the 80 gate. Two clusters of surviving mutants are genuinely meaningful: (a) ConditionalExpression mutants on the `if (!needsX) return;` guards for keys that flow-overview HAPPENS to include (predictability :277, throughput :297, and :436/:526/:623) — no existing test ever excludes them, so `if (false) return` survives; one test passing an empty key set and asserting every service method is untouched kills the whole cluster; (b) LogicalOperator/ConditionalExpression mutants on the five-way && chain in isProjectMetricsService (:99) — mutating && to || makes a team service with any single portfolio method masquerade as a portfolio service. The remaining survivors are NOT worth chasing: console.error message StringLiterals, .catch arrow bodies, and useEffect dependency-array-to-empty mutants that are equivalent for single-render tests. Test-only change; no production edit.
